description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is hiring an early-career software engineer to support a C-130J software project. The role focuses on automating a system or software process and establishing a GitLab project, baseline, and CI/CD pipeline.
Early-Career Software Engineer Asc developing software and MS&S automation, establishing GitLab baselines and CI/CD for C130J projects

Responsibilities:
• In this role, you will develop tool/script to automate a MS&S System or Software process and set up Gitlab project, baseline and CI/CD pipeline for a C130J software project
• Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities
• Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment
• Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle
• Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software
• Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls
• Ensures software standards are met

Requirements:
• The successful candidate will have experience and/or knowledge of at least one software development languages such as C, C++, C#, Java, Python, or Ada
• Must be a US Citizen
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering or electrical engineering with software programming coursework
• The candidate must have a growth mindset with a strong ability to learn quickly
• Experience with modern languages such as C, C++, C#, Python, or Ada
• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance to at least the Secret level

Preferred:
• Experience with agile methodologies, Jira, Git and automated testing
• Experience with Git/Gitlab and software review methods
• Experience with Python programming and bash scripting
• Experience with automated software test
• Designing, developing, and maintaining automated test suites
• Ability to collaborate with mult-functional teams
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
